findings.title: Member address echoed in the error
findings.detail: The thrown error contains the full email address and ends up in logs.
findings.suggestion: Throw without the address, or mask it.

findings.title: Reminder resent when marking fails
findings.detail: The email goes out before markReminded(); if marking throws, the next run mails the member again.
findings.suggestion: Mark first, or make both one transaction.
